name: What's the difference between a shower upgrade and a tub-to-shower conversion?
description: A shower upgrade refreshes existing elements; a tub-to-shower conversion replaces a tub with a new shower.

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between a shower upgrade and a tub-to-shower conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: A shower upgrade typically involves replacing existing fixtures, tiling, or the shower enclosure within the current footprint. A tub-to-shower conversion involves removing an existing bathtub and replacing it with a standalone shower. This conversion often requires more extensive plumbing and structural changes, as well as new flooring and wall finishes.
